He rolls up his sleeves, flexes his biceps, and points towards the camera with an energetic expression while a young boy in a striped shirt enters the frame. (3) The man squats down and lets the boy climb onto his back; he then lifts the boy high against the white wall. The boy clings tightly to the man's shirt and looks hesitant, while the background consists of a light gray door and white wardrobes. (4) The man continues to hold the boy against the wall, trying to get him to release his grip. The boy is laughing but scared, wrapping his arms tightly around the man's neck and refusing to let go. Visual heart overlays and sparkle effects appear around them during this affectionate interaction. (5) The roles reverse as the boy tries to push the man against the wall. The boy pushes against the man's lower torso and crotch area by mistake. The man reacts with a shocked but amused face, bending over with laughter, while the scene ends with a meme-style edit and floating heart icons.
